data.title: Previewing USMNT vs. Mexico: A friendly with everything and nothing to play for - Yahoo Sports
data.content: Overall, the USMNT is playing fun, attacking soccer that is overcoming its defensive liabilities, against Chile the team fell behind and had the determination to come back and win in fighting fashion, and the fans are singing chants riffing on Wu-Tang songs. It will be a pretty interesting matchup, not just because its one of the greatest rivalries in the sport, but because Mauricio Pochettino is still looking for his first W against El Tri. The manager has a loss in a friendly and Gold Cup final to his credit and surely an Argentine cannot let this stand. For Mexico, the team is coming off of a pair of 1-1 draws to Colombia and Peru and, like the USA, many of their best players are not available this window. As was seen against Peru and Colombia, the team hasn't quite put together the tactics that will bring his vision to life, but he's been at the helm for two games.
